title: Next.js Basics
description: Learn the basics of Next.js and the App Router.
content: Next.js is a React framework for building modern web applications. The App Router provides file-system based routing, layouts, Server Components and more.
author: Umesh

title: React Server Components
description: Understand React Server Components in Next.js.
content: Server Components allow components to render on the server. They can fetch data on the server and reduce the JavaScript sent to the browser.
author: Umesh

title: Dynamic Routes in Next.js
description: Learn how dynamic routes work in the App Router.
content: Dynamic routes use square brackets such as [slug]. They allow one page to handle multiple URLs.
author: Umesh
